top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 work is a mature, independently replicated achievement running from proglucagon and incretin physiology through identification of the active truncated peptide and receptor biology to therapies with confirmed benefit in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The Drucker, Holst and Mojsov allocation maps onto distinct documented parts of the discovery core, and the citation scope is clean. No award would be harder to justify.
